smell_validity.evidence: Six command generics absorb lower-layer internals — expires-dict deletes, raw strtoll parsing, reply-buffer refcount and accounting — displacing helpers that remain live for other callers. Command modules must extern-declare unexported symbols, proving shattered ownership; dead TTL reply branches and flattened SET guards show silent copy drift. Fault, cost, and healthy-design boundary are unmistakable without any label.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Expiry guards, parse rules, and reply-buffer bookkeeping now exist in six divergent shadow copies beside the originals they bypass. Any shared-stage fix — output-buffer handling, lazy-expire semantics, integer parsing, DEL propagation — silently misses the hottest commands across three modules; repair re-encapsulates the datastore and protocol boundaries and removes a genuine stale-behavior trap.

development_plausibility.evidence: Fits this codebase's real hot-path optimization tradition and annotated-commentary style; extern declarations, added includes, and blindly copied dead branches are faithful residue, and sites vary like accreted history. But uniformly dashed banners labelling every unfolded block with its victim function across all six sites leave self-documenting regularity real performance commits would not.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: The prompt states problem, finished state (stages regain one shared implementation; commands read as orchestration; scaffolding removed), byte-level preservation, exclusions (other large functions, over-abstraction, test weakening), and the Tcl suite as acceptance. It forecloses partial cleanups, irrelevant redesign, and anti-performance rewrites — a model natural-mode contract.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Purposes genuinely differ: argument parse, expiry-gated lookup, assignment, reply assembly, propagation. Decisions are code-supported — the hash site must release the parsed old value on its error path; SET keeps shared-object replies while GET restores bulk formatting and TTL/HINCRBY an integer ladder; EXPIRE rewrites the command vector while read paths reuse the delete-feed helper.

localization_burden.evidence: Named families route through the dispatch table to exactly six generic handlers in three files, and the supporting extern declarations and includes sit at those files' tops. One direct inspection classifies every site and all scaffolding; no cross-component data-flow combination is required.

repair_coordination.evidence: Every unfolded region reconnects to a helper that still exists and still defines the behavior, so each site follows one reconnection rule independently and single-site repairs leave behavior correct. Residual coupling is mild: scaffolding deletions wait until a module's last site reverts, plus the prompt's shared-implementation consistency demand.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: Renamed locals, dead branches, and mixed guard shapes defeat textual replacement, but in-code banners name the replaced function for nearly every region and every original survives, so one guided reconnection covers most regions of all six sites. Only GET's nested reply consolidation, the re-nested NX condition, and hash encoding arguments need site-specific judgment.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Simple wrong repairs stay visible: swapped reply bytes or mis-ordered errors surface directly under the named families. Specific slips pass ordinary calls and strike only special states: dropping the master/loading guard diverges replicas; duplicated buffer accounting bites only near the client output-buffer limit; refcount slips leak silently.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
